title: Horizon 1000: Advancing AI for primary healthcare
summary_lines: OpenAI and the Gates Foundation launch Horizon 1000, a $50M pilot advancing AI capabilities for healthcare in Africa. The initiative aims to reach 1,000 clinics by 2028.
